mapper.select: SELECT cm.COM_MATCHING_IDX AS comMatchingIdx, js.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS jobseekerName, cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE AS comMatchScore, cm.COM_AI_REASON AS comAiReason, cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX AS jobseekerIdx, cp.KEYSKILL AS keySkill, COALESCE(cp.APPLY_MOTIVE, '') AS apply FROM company_matching cm JOIN jobseeker_users js ON js.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX LEFT JOIN cover_posts cp ON cp.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX WHERE cm.COM_MATCHING_IDX = #{comMatchingIdx} LIMIT 1
